title: 1991 Soviet coup attempt
displaytitle: 1991 Soviet coup attempt

titles.display: 1991 Soviet coup attempt

description: Failed attempt to unseat Mikhail Gorbachev
extract: Between 18 and 22 August 1991, amidst the dissolution of the Soviet Union, a hardliner group of top military and civilian officials within the Communist Party of the Soviet Union (CPSU) attempted to forcibly seize power from Mikhail Gorbachev, who had been serving as the Soviet Union's president since March 1990 and as the CPSU's General Secretary since March 1985. Among the leaders of what is also known as the August Coup was Gennady Yanayev, who had been serving as the Soviet Union's vice president since December 1990.
